vulnerable_snippet: cursor.execute(usersStatement % (user.username, user.password, user.password_hint, user.totp_secret, user.created_at, user.last_login, user.real_name, user.blab_name))

cwe_name: SQL Injection
description: The application uses string formatting to construct SQL queries for inserting listeners, creating a risk of SQL injection.

cwe_name: Use of Hard-coded Credentials
description: The application uses hard-coded credentials when configuring authentication for an HTTP client.

cwe_name: Improper Certificate Validation
description: The application disables SSL certificate validation, making it vulnerable to man-in-the-middle attacks.

cwe_name: Improper Neutralization of Special Elements used in an OS Command ('OS Command Injection')
